title: A decision tied to a section prints under a question only when it bears on it
goal: pack --root _self prints a decision tied to a printed passage's doc or section only when the decision's text or source shares a key word with the question or with the pinned tested question, so a section's decisions do not follow every question that touches the section; --set and --item print them as now

run:
import re, subprocess, sys
try:
    def ids(args):
        r = subprocess.run(["python3", "_tools/rag.py", "pack", "--root", "_self"] + args, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert r.returncode == 0, "pack exit %d" % r.returncode
        return r.stdout, set(re.findall(r"\[DECISION (\S+)\]", r.stdout))
    # D-bnfzftjv (kb/_self/_decisions.csv:3): context article _self/backlog#Running a sprint, text "2, each with up to 4 workers",
    # source "backlog item ST-2jojzufm gate parallel": no key word of "what is a sprint" (kb/_self/backlog.md passage § Sprints prints)
    out, got = ids(["what is a sprint"])
    assert "§ Sprints" in out, "question no longer prints a Sprints passage"
    _, kept = ids(["--set", "kb-sprint:run"])  # --set keeps printing it
    ok = "D-bnfzftjv" not in got and "D-bnfzftjv" in kept
    print("%s: question prints %s; --set prints %s" % ("ok" if ok else "FAIL", sorted(got), sorted(kept)))
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
except Exception as e:
    print("check error", e)
    sys.exit(1)

notes: Planning 2026-10-06: the planted check packs 'what is a sprint', which prints the Sprints passage of backlog.md, and asks that D-bnfzftjv (tied to _self/backlog#Running a sprint, sharing no key word with the question) is absent while --set kb-sprint:run still prints it; today the question prints it. A shared word with the decision's text already counts; a shared source word does not and the decision prints anyway.
